title: Learn how the venture works
goal: Every kind of work the venture has done three or more times has a process record with exactly one owner, and the bottleneck to work first is named.

steps.do: Read the handoffs, evidence and process records, and list each kind of work done three or more times with no process record, most runs first.
Ask the founder which of that recurring work matters most and who owns each, one owner per process.
Draft a process record for each, with its trigger, inputs, outputs, steps, control points and measures from the handoffs.

consider.why: A process written down can be measured and improved once work repeats.
consider.when: The business is in Scale or later, or the same work has repeated often enough that the founder wants it written down.

steps.do: Ask whether anything has failed in a way the founder wants never to repeat, and draft a postmortem for each.

consider.why: A blameless review keeps a failure from repeating.
consider.when: The business is in Scale or later, or something failed in a way the founder wants never to repeat.

steps.do: Summarize the process catalog for the strategy lead: each process, its owner and health, and the bottleneck to work first.

done_criteria.check: Does every process record name exactly one owner and cite the handoffs its measures came from?
